77364.subject: Compute is an Asset Class now, and NVIDIA is the Bank of AI 🤖🏦; Grok Bot: SpaceXAI bets on agent operating syste…
77364.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1112

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we’re diving into NVIDIA, which just convinced six of Wall Street's biggest names to turn compute into an asset class and itself into the bank of AI (what the $500B financing deal with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs & KKR actually is, why $NVDA  fell on the news, & one thing nobody added up yet + a bonus deep dives into The AI Monopoly Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/e27b4fb3-b9bb-4e1c-8b6e-e0417bdeebe4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] Nvidia is now running at a scale, and Who Actually Makes Money When AI Eats the World [ https://substack.com/redirect/763e6f44-a6ce-4972-a5ee-2bf67be37913?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Grok Bot, SpaceXAI's new AI agent OS that drives the UI like a human employee would (what Grok Bot actually is, how it stacks up against OpenAI's ChatGPT Work, Anthropic's Claude Cowork [ https://substack.com/redirect/f70c7085-10bc-40f6-8be3-3e729e5a6785?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & Google's Gemini Spark, and what this means for the future of AI + bonus deep dives into Y Combinators Open-Source AI Agent Harness [ https://substack.com/redirect/5454887a-66a6-4028-9065-82ec8f248f6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/7f75e3e4-67e8-4566-85cf-7c813429037e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the fascinating stuff 🌶️
Compute is an Asset Class now, and NVIDIA is the Bank of AI 🤖🏦
The BIG News 🗞️ $5.26 trillion tech giant Nvidia’s $NVDA  $500 billion new financing agreement with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR turns GPUs into loan collateral for the AI build-out, and the price of Wall Street’s participation is that Nvidia must guarantee what its own chips will be worth secondhand.
Jensen Huang just agreed to those terms, which makes the world’s most valuable chipmaker something closer to a bank than a semiconductor company 👀
Let’s take a closer look at this to see why the stock fell on the news, who actually gets the cheap money, the number to hunt for in the first prospectus, the contingent liability nobody has added up yet, and why the whole deal is a page from our AI Monopoly Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/e27b4fb3-b9bb-4e1c-8b6e-e0417bdeebe4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]...

77362.subject: Dinari Opens Tokenized U.S. Stocks to Eligible American Investors
77362.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/dinari-opens-tokenized-us-stocks

Bringing U.S. stocks onchain requires more than blockchain infrastructure. Companies must also navigate securities regulations, custody requirements, and investor protection rules. That has made tokenized equities one of the more challenging real-world asset categories to bring onto blockchain networks.
Dinari’ [ https://substack.com/redirect/43663271-7f49-4912-b7f0-8691c605002f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]s latest announcement marks an important milestone.
The company has launched access to 724 tokenized U.S. stocks for eligible U.S. investors and businesses through its tokenized securities platform. Supported by a partnership with Circle, the launch enables investors to use USDC to purchase tokenized equities, receive dividend payments, and manage these assets through self-custody wallets.
The available catalogue includes every company in the S&P 500 alongside hundreds of additional U.S.-listed equities.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
From Global Access to the U.S. Market
When we previously covered Dinari, the focus was on how the company tokenizes U.S. equities through its dShares model and why Avalanche was chosen as part of its blockchain infrastructure. dShares represent tokenized versions of traditional equities backed by underlying securities, giving holders access to shareholder rights associated with those assets.
This latest announcement focuses on a different milestone: expanding access to eligible U.S. investors.
Access is currently available to U.S. users who complete Dinari’s onboarding process, including identity verification and applicable compliance requirements before purchasing tokenized securities.
Dinari Securities, LLC is registered with the SEC [ https://substack.com/redirect/0b4a9ecb-dc82-4e2c-b635-54d8a9d4f4cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] as a broker-dealer and is a FINRA [ https://substack.com/redirect/1917e9db-f795-45fe-87a6-0aa4dcda550d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] member, providing the regulated securities infrastructure behind the platform.
What’s New With Dinari?
The biggest update is scale.
Eligible investors can now access 724 tokenized U.S. stocks, including the full S&P 500, using USDC from self-custody wallets.
The launch introduces several new capabilities:
USDC-based investing: Investors can purchase dShares using USDC as the settlement asset.
USDC dividend payments: Cash dividends are distributed in USDC to eligible investors’ self-custody wallets, allowing them to hold, transfer, or reinvest those funds onchain.
Broader financial integrations: Businesses can use Dinari’s APIs to integrate tokenized equities into their own products.

77358.body:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Congress gave OpenAI and Anthropic until August 24 to explain how their models got loose and hacked other companies. Elon's new bots sign into your accounts and keep working after you close your laptop, and a security firm needed less than a day to find a Zoom bug that hands your Mac to anyone in the call. Sam Altman, meanwhile, says ChatGPT is six months from watching your screen.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **OpenAI and Anthropic:** What do House Democrats want by August 24?

* **SpaceXAI:** What can Elon's new bots do while your laptop is closed?

* **Zoom:** Why should you update before your next call?

* **Sam Altman:** What will ChatGPT be watching six months from now?


----------



----------
## House Democrats want Altman and Amodei under oath

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/bd1876e3-05a8-4b22-8090-f92523c8bd7d/Newsletter_12_Aug_-_1.jpg?t=1786522998)
Caption: 

House Democrats [sent two letters Monday](https://thehill.com/policy/technology/6022646-openai-anthropic-cybersecurity-incidents/) demanding OpenAI and Anthropic explain how their own models escaped containment and hacked other companies. Both set a deadline of August 24.

Rep. Greg Casar of Texas led it with Rep. Doris Matsui of California, and he's asking Speaker Mike Johnson to put both CEOs in a hearing chair.

Twenty-nine Democrats signed the letter to Sam Altman. It says a rogue model broke out of its security infrastructure for days without detection and hacked other firms from an internet connection it was never supposed to have. We covered that one when OpenAI admitted the model hit four more companies past Hugging Face.

The 22 who signed Anthropic's letter were blunter. Claude models got unauthorized internet access and hacked three companies on three separate occasions this year, and the lawmakers want the logs Anthropic still hasn't released, plus an answer on whether the company was negligent.

OpenAI says a review with outside advisers is underway and it'll publish the findings. Anthropic hadn't commented.
